folders.title: One Dental
folders.subtitle: Visual Identity - 2025
folders.content_html:
One Dental is a modern, integrated dental brand combining three essential services: a patient-focused Center, a high-precision Lab, and a forward-thinking Academy - all unified under one name and one identity. The challenge was to create a visual system that reflects this synergy.


The name “One Dental” came from a desire to unify — not only in structure but in spirit. The word “One” carries multiple layers of meaning: it speaks to leadership (being number one), cohesion (bringing everything together under one roof), and simplicity (clarity of experience). It also echoes what patients, students, and professionals alike seek from a trusted brand: one solution, one standard, one smile.
From this central idea, the visual identity took shape. The logo is minimal but rich in symbolism. A clean, circular curves subtly to suggest a smile — the universal symbol of successful dental work. Rising above it is a short vertical line, creating a quiet but confident “1.” Together, they form a mark that is both abstract and immediately legible: a number, a face, and a promise of excellence.
